### Plants maintenance agreement Brazilian gold mine 

###### **Customer need** 



Site: Kinross Paracatu Location: Minas Gerais, Brazil Units: 01 site Commercial operation:  2009 

Maintenance Services and 24/365 remote support services for the eHouses associated with the site as well as the overarching 800xA control system. 

Each eHouse has disparate ABB equipment, such as low voltage drives, medium voltage drives, low voltage MCCs, MV Switchgears (13,8kV and 4,16kV), air conditioning systems, fire detection and suppression system, automation controllers, and other OEM components. 

###### **ABB’s response** 

ABB resident engineers servicing and maintaining - in a co-sourcing agreement with the client -  the eHouses in all process areas as well as the 800xA control system. In addition, strong remote support requirement via the use of the ServicePort – ABB’s remote connection tool 

###### **Customer benefits** 

One team approach – customer and ABB in co-sourcing agreement Optimized spare parts stock and reduced costs Condition monitoring with full production

## Minerals and Mining service case study Energy and CO2 emissions savings – Anglo American 

###### **Customer need** 



Anglo American’s Kumba Sishen open cast iron ore mine in  South Africa needed to mine ever deeper in order to meet production requirements. This resulted in a steep increase in diesel fuel use, the mine’s biggest energy source.  As the Kumba mine management takes energy usage  and carbon emissions very seriously they needed a method to reduce both. 

###### **ABB’s response** 

ABB’s Energy Efficiency Consulting team, working with Anglo American identified 44 opportunities with a saving range of $9M to $15M in electricity and diesel savings were identified for the mine. After several workshops, 31 opportunities were considered “feasible” 

###### **Customer benefits** 

Site: Kumba Iron Location: Sishen, South Africa Units: 01 site Commercial operation: 1954 / 2006 

44 opportunities identified $9M to $15M p.a. potential savings to mine 31 opportunities considered $7M to $12M p.a. potential savings to mine 

Energy savings opportunity baseline CO2 reduction opportunity baseline 

4.4% - 7.5%  p.a. 5.3% -  9% p.a. 



© ABB Group July 1, 2013 | Slide 20 

### Minerals and Mining service case study Energy efficiency – LKAB, Sweden 



###### **Customer need** 

ABB to assist with increasing the yearly output of the three plants and a corresponding decrease of 20 % in energy usage. 

###### **ABB’s response** 

Implement Energy Manager software – this helps to monitor, manage and optimize the energy usage for maximum efficiency and cost savings. By providing reliable data on energy consumption and costs, it helps to pinpoint potential process improvement areas as well as identify the process area with the highest levels of energy efficiency. This data is then used as the basis of future energy saving measures. Energy efficient operations also benefit the environment by reducing carbon emissions. 

###### **Customer benefits** 

Owner: LKAB Location: Sweden Units: 3  sites (Kiruna and Malmbergiet underground i

ron ore mines as well as Svappavaara open pit mine) 

One team approach – customer and ABB in co-sourcing Easy to implement and use software with low maintenance requirements 

Reliable data
